description: In a PA model in the fixed ambient universe, the specified bound-transport program converts an accepted proof of a signed bounded-quantifier formula with evaluated numeral bound into an accepted proof with the original closed term bound, for either quantifier and either sign. The body and terms are those of the supplied shared-syntax formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedBoundTransport.certified_transportBound
  {M : Type} [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {α : Type} [Fintype α] {r : ℕ} (universal negative : Bool)
  (name : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program r)
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term α)
  (D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (α ⊕ Unit))
  (pQuant : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program r) (x : Fin r → M)
  (hq :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier (pQuant.value x)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundTermTransport.quantifiedValue
        universal negative
        ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedSyntaxPrograms.slotFormula 0
              name D).value
          x)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.numeralSyntax
          ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.namedTermValue
                name t).value
            x)))) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier
    ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedBoundTransport.transportBound
          universal negative name t D pQuant).value
      x)
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundTermTransport.quantifiedValue
      universal negative
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedSyntaxPrograms.slotFormula 0
            name D).value
        x)
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.namedTermCode name
            t).value
        x))
